notes: Card: ' grounds' x23 and ' ground' x7 of the top 32 (one token dominates). Probes: school grounds 0.69, coffee grounds 0.58, 'on the grounds that' 0.30, singular ' ground' 0.16, ' field' / ' premises' 0.06-0.08. Near misses swap in field, yard, premises, land, and two singular ' ground'.
